cli.runningProcesses_other: {{count}} CC processes active — symlink swap is safe (old processes keep their version)

desktop.notManageable: Desktop is managed by {{source}} — Claudepot can't drive updates here
desktop.isRunning: Desktop is currently running — quit it before updating

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Notifications and pinning
settings.trayBadgeHint: tray badge when a new version is available
settings.osNotifyHint: OS notification (toast) when a new version is available
settings.sourceNote: Channel + DISABLE_* keys live in ~/.claude/settings.json (CC's own file). Notification toggles + cadence live in ~/.claudepot/updates.json.

channel.untrackedHint: Claude Code is set to the "{{channel}}" update channel. Anthropic publishes no version feed for it, so Claudepot cannot say whether a newer Claude Code exists on it. Choose latest or stable to resume update checks.

auto.title: Auto-memory
auto.description: Lets CC build a per-project memory directory and auto-write topic files at session end. Per-project overrides live in Projects → Memory.
auto.overridden: Overridden by {{label}}. Clear the env var to control this from here.

health.title: Memory health
health.subtitle: Static analysis of CLAUDE.md and MEMORY.md.
health.cutoffNote: CC truncates global memory after line {{line}}.
health.fileMissing: File not present — nothing to audit.

dream.title: Background memory consolidation
dream.description: Lets Claude Code review recent sessions in the background and distill them into memory. Default follows Claude Code's own rollout; override it here.
dream.requiresAutoMemory: Requires auto-memory, which is off — consolidation won't run until it's enabled above.
